pages.text: The $(item)Mob Farm$() "kills" mobs for their drops. It needs a $(item)sword$() plus the food or item that mob needs as input.$(br2)Its floor is lava with stone.$(br2)$(thing)Ingredients$(): 5 glass panes (any), 1 lava bucket, 1 sword (any), 2 iron ingots.
Glass panes over a lava bucket, with a sword between two iron ingots below.
Inputs follow the original Mob Farms mod: for example porkchops for pigs, raw beef for cows. See $(l:easy_farms:mob_recipes/passive)Mob Farm Recipes$() for every mob.
